items.prompt: Which statement follows from the min-heap invariant?

options.text: The entire backing array is globally sorted
options.why: Siblings and unrelated subtrees need not be ordered.

options.text: The root contains a minimum element
options.why: Every descendant is at least its ancestors under the ordering.

options.text: Every equal-priority payload is automatically FIFO
options.why: Tie order needs an explicit secondary key.

options.text: Any arbitrary element update preserves the invariant
options.why: Changing a key can require a heap repair.

items.explanation: The heap partial order is enough to identify the minimum at the root. It does not impose every ordering relation of a sorted array.
